params.body:
The Stocklist platform's new read `photos_sample` (stocklistdealer-eu/platform #1007) is not an aggregate: it serves real vehicle photos with remove.bg's cut-outs and the dealer backgrounds, for the trial of the own cut-out service, under its own mandate kind `stocklist.photos_read`.

The systems MCP took every Stocklist tool for a count and appended "Aggregates only: no garage names, no people, no cars" to its description. It now reads the `kind` the platform's menu gives each tool and describes the sample as what it is: real photos with their plates, two-hour addresses, no garage names, under `stocklist.photos_read` on the same 30-day word. The bundled menu snapshot carries the tool for a machine that never reached the platform, and the README has the row and a paragraph on the one read that is not a count.

Test: a menu with `usage` and `photos_sample` yields the aggregate sentence on the one and the photo sentence on the other. `node --test mcp/systems.test.mjs`: 7 of 7.
params.title: Describe Stocklist's photo sample by its own kind in the systems MCP
